text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Happy birthday, Tact! Just as promised, 
we're throwing you a massive party♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
I've sent invitations to plenty of people, 
and the dance hall is already decorated. 
Catering and showtime are perfect too!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Eeh, such a lavish celebration...! Are you 
sure it's okay?

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I celebrate, it won't 
be enough! After all, this is the day you 
came into this world, isn't it? Yes, I am 
profoundly grateful for this miracle.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Heart-san... I'm the one who should be 
thanking you. Because the only reason I am 
who I am today is because you were there 
for me, Heart-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Meeting you, looking up to you, the 
courage you gave me... All of those things 
are what made me who I am.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If I've truly become a wonderful Umamusume 
who deserves to be celebrated like this... 
it's all because you were so wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Tact... Ahhh—to hear that coming from 
someone like you...

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
(It certainly wasn't an easy road...\nYet 
every step had meaning. And the proof of 
that is...)

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, how strange. It feels like I'm the 
one who received a gift. Thank you for 
being born.
